integrity: Complete proof and reproducible independently implemented finite computations are included. The same-author mathematical checks are not an independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: The all-prime-power shattering criterion and VC/Littlestone formula are proved. Exact mod-two homology is asserted only for q=2, n=1,2,3. No integral homology, all-rank homotopy, or independent priority certification is claimed; unindexed isotropic-frame results may have equivalent coverage.
title: Lagrangian incidence shattering: isotropic partial frames and exact finite topology
